articles.summary:
### Summary
A single gossipsub peer can grow a node's `topics` map without bound by flooding subscription RPCs, because the default configuration has no global, per-peer, or topic-length cap and peer scoring does not penalise subscription volume. The peer is never greylisted, so the growth continues toward OOM.

A remote peer can stall a js-libp2p node's entire event loop for ~4–5 seconds per connection (and transiently allocate ~2 GB) by sending a ~15-byte crafted `publicKey` inside an Identify message. articles.title: CVE-2026-130354 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in POST /api/webauthn/prepare that creates accounts as active, bypassing manual activation and domain whitelisting. Anonymous attackers can obtain the freely issued CSRF token and register an activated account with an unverified email to access registered-user-only content and functions.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130353 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in its public FAQ REST API that exposes author names and e-mail addresses to unauthenticated callers. Attackers can query the faq and paginated faqs endpoints to bulk-harvest e-mails and de-anonymise users who opted out of GDPR author visibility.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130348 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that exposes restricted and inactive category metadata to unauthenticated visitors. Attackers can enumerate category IDs via /category/{id}/{slug}.html or query /api/v4.0/categories to read names, descriptions, images and FAQ counts of restricted categories.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130347 — CVSS 4.8
articles.summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass in password reset, letting external-identity accounts receive local passwords. Attackers with mailbox access can request reset tokens for OIDC, Keycloak, Entra ID, LDAP, SSO, or WebAuthn accounts and log in locally, skipping IdP MFA and deprovisioning.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130346 — CVSS 3.1
articles.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver because idf_escape() doubles backticks but does not escape backslashes in identifiers. Attackers can lure a logged-in user into opening a GET link with a column name ending in a backslash in columns, where, or order parameters, causing query text to be parsed as SQL.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130344 — CVSS 3.0
articles.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Admin::printTablePartitions() that allows authenticated users to inject HTML by placing markup in partition column names. Attackers with CREATE or ALTER privileges can create a partitioned table whose unescaped partition expression executes script when another user opens the table-structure page.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130341 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject javascript: links via FAQ comments. When the comment editor is enabled, Utils::parseUrl() strips https:// from sanitized hrefs, turning an allowed https://javascript:443/ link into executable script that runs on the shared admin origin when clicked.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130338 — CVSS 4.6
articles.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored sql injection vulnerability in the MySQL driver that allows database users with table creation rights to inject SQL through unescaped geometry column names in unconvert_field(). Attackers can craft a column name containing an SQL expression that executes with another AdminNeo user's privileges when they edit a row, save it, or export the table.
